final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry line and matching the timestamp, level, service, and message. I filtered only ERROR and CRITICAL entries (case insensitive). For each entry, I collected any extra lines (traceback) until the next entry or repeat line. I summed the repeat counts from any following repeat lines. I converted timestamps to UTC ISO format. I extracted the last line of the traceback as the exception or set it to null if none. I aggregated the repeat counts by service. Finally, I wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
